text: Ohhh… why is it so hot in here? Is the air-con broken?
My head… boom, boom, boom. Like a drum!
Cough, cough… sorry… I sound like a goat!
Look at my arm! Red spots! Am I turning into a tomato?
I am freezing! But my forehead is burning.
I can't stop scratching!
I cannot turn my head. It is so stiff!
I do not want food. Not even my favourite noodles.
I am so hot! Can I sleep in the fridge?
Cough, cough! The whole ward is moving away from me.
Look at my arm! I look like a strawberry!
Red spots on my arms. They itch, but my face is fine.
A mosquito bit me a week ago. Now I am sick.
Her temperature is forty-one degrees. Normal is about thirty-seven.
Her platelets are ninety-five thousand. Normal is one hundred and fifty to four hundred and fifty thousand.
Her pulse is one hundred and thirty. Normal is sixty to one hundred.
She breathes forty times a minute. Normal is twelve to twenty.
Her temperature is thirty-two degrees. Normal is about thirty-seven.
The lab says my platelets are ninety-five thousand. The normal range is one hundred and fifty to four hundred and fifty thousand. Is that okay?
Thirty-eight point one. Normal is thirty-seven… so a bit high?
My pulse is forty-eight. Normal is sixty to one hundred. Am I a robot?
No cough. Not even a little one.
It started on Monday. So… three days.
We all ate the same lunch. Nobody else is sick, thank goodness.
Measles? I doubt it. It is unlikely.
Dengue? I'm nearly sure. It is probably dengue.
It might be flu, it might be dengue. I can't decide!
She has a fever, but no cough. Strange.
Her eyes are fine. Not red, not watery.
Two measles vaccines. She even has the card!
Although I feel awful, I still want to go to class!
Mosquito bites, so it might be dengue.
My friends ate the same food, so it is probably not food poisoning.
No cough. Not even a little one. My cat coughs more than me!
A mosquito bit me a week ago, by the pond. A big one!
Dengue?! How do you know? Are you a doctor?
My heart is fine. Totally normal. Stop looking at the monitor!
I have had a fever for two days. Okay, maybe two and a half.
Same lunch as my friends. Nobody else is sick.
